group_members_user_unique.name: group_members_user_unique
group_members_user_unique.where: "finances"."group_members"."user_id" is not null and "finances"."group_members"."archived_at" is null

group_members_update_member.name: group_members_update_member
group_members_update_member.withCheck: ((select private.is_group_leader("finances"."group_members"."group_id")) or "finances"."group_members"."user_id" = (select auth.uid())) and ("finances"."group_members"."user_id" is distinct from (select auth.uid()) or "finances"."group_members"."archived_at" is null)

generated.as: case when from_account_id is null then 'income' when to_account_id is null then 'expense' else 'transfer' end

transactions_owner_xor_group.name: transactions_owner_xor_group
transactions_owner_xor_group.value: ("finances"."transactions"."owner_user_id" is not null)::int + ("finances"."transactions"."group_id" is not null)::int = 1

recurring_rules_day_of_month_by_frequenc.name: recurring_rules_day_of_month_by_frequency
recurring_rules_day_of_month_by_frequenc.value: case when "finances"."recurring_rules"."frequency" = 'weekly' then "finances"."recurring_rules"."day_of_month" is null else "finances"."recurring_rules"."day_of_month" is not null end

goal_contributions_select_member.name: goal_contributions_select_member
goal_contributions_select_member.using: exists (select 1 from "finances"."savings_goals" g where g.id = "finances"."goal_contributions"."goal_id" and (g.owner_user_id = (select auth.uid()) or private.is_group_member(coalesce(g.group_id, private.owner_group_id(g.owner_user_id)))))

goal_contributions_insert_member.name: goal_contributions_insert_member
goal_contributions_insert_member.withCheck: exists (select 1 from "finances"."savings_goals" g where g.id = "finances"."goal_contributions"."goal_id" and g.archived_at is null and (g.owner_user_id = (select auth.uid()) or private.is_group_member(g.group_id)))

goal_contributions_delete_member.name: goal_contributions_delete_member
goal_contributions_delete_member.using: exists (select 1 from "finances"."savings_goals" g where g.id = "finances"."goal_contributions"."goal_id" and (g.owner_user_id = (select auth.uid()) or private.is_group_member(g.group_id)))

installment_lines_select.name: installment_lines_select
installment_lines_select.using: exists (select 1 from "finances"."installment_plans" p where p.id = "finances"."installment_lines"."plan_id" and private.can_read_account(p.account_id))

installment_lines_insert.name: installment_lines_insert
installment_lines_insert.withCheck: exists (select 1 from "finances"."installment_plans" p where p.id = "finances"."installment_lines"."plan_id" and private.can_write_account(p.account_id))

installment_lines_update.name: installment_lines_update
installment_lines_update.using: exists (select 1 from "finances"."installment_plans" p where p.id = "finances"."installment_lines"."plan_id" and private.can_write_account(p.account_id))
installment_lines_update.withCheck: exists (select 1 from "finances"."installment_plans" p where p.id = "finances"."installment_lines"."plan_id" and private.can_write_account(p.account_id))

installment_lines_delete.name: installment_lines_delete
installment_lines_delete.using: exists (select 1 from "finances"."installment_plans" p where p.id = "finances"."installment_lines"."plan_id" and private.can_write_account(p.account_id))

audit_log_select_scope.name: audit_log_select_scope
audit_log_select_scope.using: ("finances"."audit_log"."owner_user_id" = (select auth.uid()) or ("finances"."audit_log"."group_id" is not null and (select private.is_group_member("finances"."audit_log"."group_id"))) or "finances"."audit_log"."actor_user_id" = (select auth.uid()))

ingest_deliveries_category_source_presen.name: ingest_deliveries_category_source_present
ingest_deliveries_category_source_presen.value: "finances"."ingest_deliveries"."proposed_category_id" is null or "finances"."ingest_deliveries"."category_source" is not null
